description: Landslides in the Czech Republic – INSPIRE download service (theme Natural risk zones) is a dataset listed in EGDI Metadata Catalogue, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by app.geology.cz. INSPIRE Download Service (ATOM feed) provides access to mapped landslides in the Czech Republic. Coverage: Europe. Its keywords include EGDI. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geology-cz.
